name: local-time-tracker
title: Local Time Tracker
description: Track project work locally in Raycast
author: yoshinyan

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Menu Bar Timer
commands.subtitle: View the running timer
commands.description: Show the active timer in the menu bar

preferences.name: dailyAlertEnabled
preferences.title: Daily Work Alert
preferences.description: Notify once per day when total tracked work reaches the threshold.
preferences.label: Enable alert

preferences.name: dailyAlertMinutes
preferences.title: Daily Alert (Minutes)
preferences.description: Positive whole minutes; invalid values use 480.

preferences.name: timerAlertEnabled
preferences.title: Work Timer Alert
preferences.description: Notify once per work timer when elapsed time reaches the threshold.
preferences.label: Enable alert

preferences.name: timerAlertMinutes
preferences.title: Timer Alert (Minutes)
preferences.description: Positive whole minutes; invalid values use 480.

preferences.name: pomodoroEnabled
preferences.title: Pomodoro
preferences.label: Enable Pomodoro
preferences.description: Allow Pomodoro alongside work tracking. Disabling ends the Pomodoro session on the next menu bar refresh; work tracking continues.

preferences.name: workMinutes
preferences.title: Pomodoro Work (Minutes)
preferences.description: Positive whole minutes; invalid values use 25.

preferences.name: shortBreakMinutes
preferences.title: Pomodoro Short Break (Minutes)
preferences.description: Positive whole minutes; invalid values use 5.

preferences.name: longBreakMinutes
preferences.title: Pomodoro Long Break (Minutes)
preferences.description: Positive whole minutes; invalid values use 15.

preferences.name: longBreakEvery
preferences.title: Work Intervals Before Long Break
preferences.description: Positive whole number; invalid values use 4.
